name: skechers.com.uy
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 19 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: skechers.com.uy scores 60 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 34 pass. Fix first: 19 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 19 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /catalogo, /mujer, /mujer?ord=new, /catalogo?grp=154 and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /catalogo, /mujer, for example .__icommkt_modal_close_button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /catalogo, /mujer, for example #cboOrdenCatalogo. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw TikTok Pixel (9 requests), Microsoft Clarity (7 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Google Analytics (8 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies _ttp on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /catalogo, /mujer, for example .tiendasCnt > a[href$="locales"] and .whatsappFloat. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
